description: A part of the business where each term has one meaning and one model, such as Catalog versus Inventory, and the natural boundary for a module or service.
An object with an identity that persists while its attributes change, so two orders with the same lines are still different orders.
An immutable object defined only by its values, such as `Money` or `Address`, which a C# `record` models with built-in value equality.
The single entity through which a cluster of objects is loaded and changed, so it can enforce the cluster's invariants inside one transaction.
An antipattern where entities are data bags with public setters and all business rules live in service classes.
The EF Core mapping for a value object: no key, stored in the owner's table or a JSON column, and compared by value.
A record of something meaningful that happened in the domain, collected by the aggregate and dispatched when the unit of work is saved.
An event published to other modules or services after the transaction commits, typically through an outbox and a message broker.
